user_question: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Dissolve county subdivisions
workflow_steps.purpose: Create a unified Centre County boundary from the supplied county subdivision polygons.
workflow_steps.instructions: Dissolve all features in the county subdivision layer into a unified boundary geometry.

workflow_steps.title: Clip tracts to county boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Restrict the tract polygons to the dissolved Centre County boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip the supplied tract polygon layer using the dissolved county boundary.

workflow_steps.title: Aggregate hospital beds by tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate total hospital beds within each Centre County tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Spatially assign hospital points to the clipped tract polygons and sum the BEDS field for each polygon. Store the result in a field named total_beds.

workflow_steps.title: Create total hospital beds choropleth
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce the requested interactive choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an interactive HTML choropleth from the tract layer, visualizing the total_beds field.
